## TPG Mortgage Investment Trust, Inc. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Common Dividend of $0.24 per Share


September 15, 2026 at 4:30 PM EDT


[PDF Version](https://www.mitt.tpg.com/node/14296/pdf)


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 15, 2026-- TPG Mortgage Investment Trust, Inc. (NYSE: MITT) (the “Company”) announced today that its Board of Directors declared a dividend of $0.24 per common share for the third quarter 2026. The dividend is payable on October 30, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on September 30, 2026.


**About TPG Mortgage Investment Trust, Inc.**


TPG Mortgage Investment Trust, Inc. is a residential mortgage REIT with a focus on investing in a diversified risk-adjusted portfolio of residential mortgage-related assets in the U.S. mortgage market. The Company is externally managed and advised by AG REIT Management, LLC, an affiliate of TPG Inc. (NASDAQ: TPG).


Additional information can be found on the Company’s website at[www.mitt.tpg.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.mitt.tpg.com&esheet=54604124&newsitemid=20260915329318&lan=en-US&anchor=www.mitt.tpg.com&index=1&md5=519194ad9378ccbfeda9529ac9a93557) .
